preamble: Two slices: sign-in with its session, and orders over it.

slices.name: authentication
brief: Delivers sign-in and the session it issues; a session cannot be verified without a sign-in to issue it, so the two stems are one build.

slices.name: orders
brief: Delivers order creation and cancellation for a signed-in caller; verified by placing and cancelling an order under a session from `authentication`.
